feedback_rule: A second attempt may see only its own rejected patch and visible-test error, not withheld regression tests or gold source. A visible-pass/regression-fail job stops without model feedback. Provider error or mapping drift stops unresolved without automatic paid retries. Every attempt is retained; source is never manually repaired.
verification_rule: Strict existing-source allowlist diff, exact patch context, source syntax, exact visible testcase identities and passes, no degradation of frozen public regression dispositions, then fresh-container replay of the accepted patch. Reports and test trees are never patchable. Expected failures are not counted as passes.
scope: Localized patch generation on six public BugsInPy bugs with execution in historical-compatible containers. Not autonomous repository navigation, novel hidden tests, production repair, ability calibration or an allocation-policy comparison. Repeated corpus/repository cases are clustered, not six independent repositories.
